title: Allow --reroute from any phase after a completed implement round (code_review, qa, human_review)
_pr_pinning: the PR number pinned by --pr lives in the gitignored sidecar tasks/<id>/.pr-number (not in this file); --ship reads it for forge-proof merge verification. Sidecar absence is valid (legacy/pre-PR state).

escalations.reason: Spec review hit 3 changes_requested iterations in a row (limit: 3). Pipeline auto-blocked before the next spec revision. Read the latest spec-review.md: if review is still converging (each round narrows on distinct, legitimate findings), raise the cap and continue — MAX_REVIEW_LOOPS=<n> canon run relax-reroute-gate-post-implement. Only rescope if prior iterations no longer apply — run canon task reset-spec-review relax-reroute-gate-post-implement to archive the prior review, clear the loop counters, and drop the stored Claude session. Resetting accepts the current spec as-is, so the next run enters `spec_review` without another spec revision. Raise the cap instead if you want the deferred spec revision to run before review. Resuming after raising the cap runs `spec` first — the deferred revision — then `spec_review` again.

_verdict_values: approved | approved_with_nits | changes_requested | needs_re_review (legacy alias, routed/counted as changes_requested) | spec_gap | sanctioned (operator-only via canon task accept)
_full_send: true → skip spec gate + auto-open draft PR after clean QA. See docs/pipeline-orchestrator.md (`--full-send`).
